popover.title: Browser agent
popover.intro: An AI agent built into your browser can read this template, check it and make changes you can undo. It uses your browser's own agent: this page holds no API key.
popover.polyfill: Development mode: tools come from the WebMCP polyfill.

settings.enabled: Let browser agents use this builder
settings.enabledHelp: Turn off to remove every tool at once.
settings.askBeforeEditHelp: Each change the agent makes waits for your OK.
settings.problem: Some tools could not be registered: {{detail}}

log.title: Recent activity
log.empty: Nothing yet. Ask your browser's agent to work on this template, and each step shows up here.

actions.load_sample: open a sample in place of this template

confirm.title: Allow this browser agent action?
confirm.allowSession: Allow previews for the rest of this session

details.replace_template: It opens as a new draft named “{{name}}” with {{sections}} scenes; Undo brings your current draft back.
details.load_sample: The sample “{{title}}” opens as a new draft; Undo brings your current draft back.
details.render_preview: It renders about {{duration}} s of video in your browser with placeholder media, roughly {{seconds}} s of work, and opens the preview here.
details.save_template: It saves “{{name}}” to your template library on this device; the builder stays open.
